info.description: ONE ENTRY PER CLASS on /academics/class-corner/class-timetable/, each holding that class's section sheets. ⚠⚠ A COLLECTION, NOT ONE BIG SINGLE TYPE, SO THE SCHOOL CAN UPDATE ONE CLASS WITHOUT OPENING THE OTHER FOURTEEN — replacing Class VI's sheets at the start of a term should not put Class XII's at risk in the same save. ⚠ `stage` IS WHAT GROUPS THE PAGE. A class with a stage the page does not know about simply will not appear, so the five values are fixed here rather than free text.

label.description: As the school writes it — 'Class I', 'KG II', 'Nursery'.

stage.description: The school's own five stages, the same ones /academics/structure/ uses.

order.description: Sort order WITHIN the stage. Lower first. Renumber to move a class.
